ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
祥拒绝了重组Ave Mujica的邀请。
她肯定会为我重组CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
CRYCHIC的祥看起来总是很幸福。
可是，Ave Mujica的祥……看起来一直很痛苦……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
祥也一样。遇见灯的歌词之后，
祥才组建了CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
CRYCHIC成为了祥珍视的乐队，
让她一直无法忘怀

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
CRYCHIC已经毁了
所以这次我想好好坚持的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
初华，你闭嘴。
灯，我们组CRYCHIC吧。这样祥也会更幸福

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你又不属于CRYCHIC，你懂什么

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我说了，我想……
再一次组CRYCHIC……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……不是CRYCHIC的，春日影

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是我……毁了CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我想再一次和祥组CRYCHIC

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Mortis？让我和祥见面

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Mortis，求你了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: Mortis，你要理解我

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
对不起。我……毁了乐队，
我弹得不好……我一直都很想道歉……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
为什么，我总是把事情弄糟……
总是失败呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: （不能失败不能失败不能失败不能失——）

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
拍新化妆品的广告，剧集采访……
还有……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 是在月之森第一个组建乐队的，高中部的学姐

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 求你了，让我和祥见面。我要和祥说话

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我……从来没觉得乐队有什么开心的

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 重新出道才过了一周而已

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……爽世现在在组乐队。
她也邀请我了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 演出那天，应该能见到爽世她们

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 你说交给你，结果却是这样。太过分了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……黄瓜。
那边是番茄……这边是茄子……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 因为我发消息给你，你也不回复……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 快去阻止爽世。别让她去祥家

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……爽世很担心你。
说想去你家……

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_029
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 除了Mujica，祥已经一无所有了……！
